# A frustration-free normal form for weak Pauli clocks

29 October 2026. This is a NEW continuation; the earlier `two_body_phase/`
package is unchanged. No model, clock matrix or finite code level is rerun.

**Status.** The construction below gives a parameter-qualified route to
arbitrary bounded-range physical perturbation stability. It uses spatial
quasi-locality and a frustration-free normal form, followed by an explicit
polynomial-buffer localization argument. It does NOT assert that a spatial
spectral flow has the support-volume norm used by Yin--Lucas. The literal
previously compiled value of lambda has NOT been numerically compared with
the additional smallness constant in Section 5. A uniformly smaller positive
constant lambda is allowed; its penalty remains independent of system size.

The two new load-bearing elementary operations are the operator-valued
vacuum martingale in Section 3 and the polynomial-buffer block-diagonal
localization in Section 7. Ordinary exact spectral-flow filters, Lieb--Robinson
bounds, and the Bravyi--Hastings--Michalakis bootstrap are explicitly retained
as prior tools. No priority or physical feasibility is inferred.

## 1. Qualified input and result

Use the commuting positive Pauli checks, bounded weight w, bounded incidence r,
clock dimension L, exact prefix gauge U, and H'(lambda;S) from the frozen proof.
For formal independent signs s, the scaled clock Hamiltonian is

    H_s(v) = Naux + v V_s,   Naux=sum_i Q_i,
    Q_i=I-|0><0|_i,         0<=v<=rho.

All its clock ground states are simple and have gap at least 1/2, uniformly in
s, v and the number of clocks. No entire zero-ancilla spectral band is isolated.
The vacuum energy obeys the already acquired identity and local bound

    E(S)=b I-2lambda^L sum_c S_c+R(S),
    max_c sum_(X containing c)|R_X| <= lambda^L/2              (1)

for 0<lambda<=lambda_*=rho^L/12. Set Delta=1/(4lambda^L).

In addition, the data and clock cells have a uniform spatial metric of
polynomial growth:

    |B_R(x)| <= nu (1+R)^D.                                  (2)

All source checks and gauged clock interactions have fixed spatial range.
These are the source-qualified bounded-density geometry premises, NOT a
property inferred from the finite ell3 compiler. All constants may depend
on this fixed geometry, w,r,L, but not on N.

The source code has distance d_N and check-soundness cutoff d

## 8a. Pay quasilocal initial terms in the filtered interaction

This section supplies the radius summation and uniform LR gate used in
(30). It also avoids the invalid operation of integrating a raw
exp(v|t|) Duhamel bound against a subexponential filter.

Anchor the positive background summands and the perturbation as

    h_x=sum_(r>=0)h_x,r,  v_x=sum_(r>=0)v_x,r,
    supp h_x,r, supp v_x,r subset B_r(x),
    ||h_x,r||<=a(r), ||v_x,r||<=epsilon b(r),
    a(r)+b(r)<=A exp[-a0 r^beta0], beta0>0.                 (32)

Fixed polynomial factors are absorbed by lowering a0. Sections3--5 give
exactly such a bound for the background; the finite-depth and spectral-flow
maps give it for the transformed perturbation. The potentially huge fixed
Delta is part of A, not a size-dependent parameter.

**Uniform LR constants.** For two sites at distance d, the interaction
pair sum from (32) is bounded by

    nu sum_(r>=d/2)(1+r)^D a(r),                            (33)

since a common support B_r(x) requires r>=d/2, and there are at most
nu(1+r)^D possible centers x. This is bounded by
C exp[-a1 d^beta0], for a1>0 independent of N; the same is true with
any fixed power of support size inserted. Choose a slightly slower

    F(d)=(1+d)^(-D-2) exp[-a2 d^beta],
    0<beta<min(1,beta0), a2>0 sufficiently small.

It is a standard summable convolution F-function on a polynomial-growth
metric space (the usual split at distance d/2 proves the convolution
bound). Equation (33) bounds the F-norms of Hbar+sV uniformly for
0<=s<=1 and all finite systems. Thus their LR constants are uniform,
despite the quasilocal initial interaction. The same check applies to
the spectral-flow generator's interaction after its weighted-integral
localization. Its strength is O(epsilon), because its input derivative is V.

**The needed local-input map bound.** Write

    K_s=Ad_(U_s) F_s-F_0,   L_s=Ad_(U_s) F_s.

For a local A supported in X=B_r(x), ordinary Duhamel/LR estimates give

    ||K_s(A)||<=C epsilon (1+r)^b0 ||A||,
    ||(I-Pi_(B_(r+ell)(x)))K_s(A)||
          <=C epsilon (1+r)^b0 ||A|| g(ell),                (34)

and the same bounds for L_s without epsilon. Here b0 is one fixed
polynomial power; b0=4 ceil(D)+4 is a safe choice. The decreasing g can
be taken stretched exponential, with all moments finite. Pi is any
norm-contracting local product conditional expectation used for the
spatial s

# Root analytic review of the two-body clock stability transfer

Root whole-read b_conventional/clock_stability/PROOF.md, including the added
quasilocal initial-Hamiltonian argument in section8a, on29October2026.
ACCEPTED at its parameter-qualified mathematical scope. This is a substantive
analytic internal review; no new finite-model run or physical validation.

The sectorwise use of spectral flow is legitimate: the derivative and all
dynamics preserve the formal check signs, and every clock ground fiber has
the same positive intra-sector gap. A global band isolating all those fibers
is not required for this projection identity. LR locality follows separately
from local interaction/filter bounds. Pullback through dependent physical
checks is a norm-contracting homomorphism; whole-check support is retained.

Root checked the vacuum martingale exactly. Product vacuum expectations and
formal-sign averaging preserve Hermiticity and fiberwise vacuum annihilation.
Anchored differences receive contributions only from terms containing their
anchor. Ball differences thus have the stated tail and Q_B T Q_B property.
Allocating explicit scalar tail majorants from the onsite penalties produces
an exact positive FF interaction. The large excited-clock terms are paid by
those penalties, rather than falsely declared small in absolute norm.

Marked amplitudes live in the SAME unmerged l1 power-series algebra as the KT
contraction. Differentiation counts multiplicities before regrouping signs or
physical relations. Connected-cluster support and the convergence disk pay
the spatial tails of the syndrome-energy remainder, not just its total norm.
Positive per-check allocation then retains the source local ground projectors.
The new FF restricted Hamiltonians have exactly the bare-code/vacuum kernels
and a uniform local gap; this is not asserted for cut original clock rings.

Polynomial check soundness implies polynomial-buffer compression of EVERY
local observable. Applying it to O^dagger O gives the exact norm identity
||O P_local||=||O P_global||. Root reconstructed the telescoping localization:
global block diagonality makes the offending compressed pieces controlled by
the discarded spatial tail; nesting makes each difference annihilate the
larger local projector. The relative-form cost is a sum of polynomial overlap
counts times a rapid tail, hence finite uniformly in N.
